episodes.title: Rosie O'Donnell Just Made A BIG MOVE On Epstein
episodes.description:
Rosie O’Donnell says ABC rejected her proposal to feature eight Jeffrey Epstein survivors during her August guest-hosting run on Jimmy Kimmel Live!, so she met with the women herself and released their video online instead. O’Donnell has since said she wants to produce longer interviews with the survivors, while federal prosecutors in Manhattan have separately opened an investigation into Epstein’s longtime lawyer Darren Indyke and accountant Richard Kahn, who now manage his estate and deny wrongdoing. Ring of Fire's Josh G. explains.
